svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)
AXI XIP and serial engine use separate clocks. One serial datapath selects i_clk_serial for controller mode or i_spi_sclk_tgt for target mode only while idle.
Four asynchronous clock domains; one shared serial datapath
APB, AXI, SPIN, SPOT, APCLK, AXCLK,
APB address decode, response mux and custom TX/RX FIFO data-window access
AXI4 XIP subordinate, burst tracking and read-response assembly
Shared controller/target shift datapath and phase control
Glitch-free selection between controller clock and external target SCLK
Role/phase-controlled SCLK, CS and IO lane direction
Buffer APB program data for serial transmission
Buffer serial receive data for APB software reads
Request/response and status crossings between APB, AXI, serial and target domains
Reset-release synchronization for each receiving clock domain
